## Not Just Another AI Company. This is Our Story.

We didn’t set out to build just another AI company.

**We set out to build an AI-guided future for GTM teams—a future where AI isn’t just a tool, but a partner that works alongside you, evolves with you, and guides you through every step, signal, and shift.**

In our everyday lives, we rely on systems of guidance: Uber helps us reach our destinations effortlessly. Waze gets us there faster. Tesla offers hands-free driving.

At Aviso, we set out to bring intelligent guidance to GTM teams. And for that, we’re harnessing every evolution in AI—from Predictive AI to GenAI to Agentic AI, and progressing toward AGI—to help you navigate unpredictability with precision and future-proof revenue growth.

## A Force To Reckon With. About Trevor.

Trevor developed a passion for Chess at 4, Go at 6, and graduated high school 2 years ahead of schedule. He holds multiple masters in econometrics, accounting, MIS, quantitative game theory. Beyond academics, Trevor’s life is a mix of adrenaline and discipline—from Formula 3 racing to rugby fields in South Africa and New Zealand. He’s also a lifelong practitioner of Marcus Aurelius school of Stoicism.

Starting his career as a strategy consultant, Trevor transformed enterprise selling playbooks at Salesforce and Oracle, closing some of their largest deals—achieving 1400% of quota as Director of Global Accounts. Over nine years, he served as a leading Global Account Manager and held senior leadership roles including RVP and AVP at both Oracle and Salesforce.

From 2009 to 2014, Trevor was a key driver behind Salesforce’s explosive growth, scaling mid-market revenue from $800M to $4B, and turning their top-producing region into a dominant enterprise force. Later, as CRO at Tact.ai and CipherCloud, and as a SaaS board advisor, Trevor helped industry leaders adopt advanced sales technologies.

At Aviso, Trevor architected the guided selling vision, driving 20+ patents across conversational intelligence, AutoML, AI, sync, and people graphs. He has channeled over 20 years of frontline B2B sales experience into creating an AI guidance platform that redefines selling—closing the gap between deal execution and forecasting with precision.

Trevor’s mission? To empower every sales team with an AI-guided future where humans and AI collaborate to crush goals.
